idea: A specialty coffee kiosk at a Barcelona metro exit, €3 flat whites for commuters

mia.title: Specialty coffee kiosk in Barcelona
mia.one_liner: Specialty coffee in 90 seconds at the metro exit, open from 7:00.

brief.concept: A 40 m² takeaway-only specialty coffee kiosk next to a busy metro exit in Eixample.
brief.for: Commuters aged 25 to 45 who buy coffee on the way to work and hate queues.
brief.goal: Sell 60 cups at a pop-up cart and collect 30 pre-orders within 4 weeks.

checklist.task: Count morning footfall at two metro exits
checklist.how: Stand at each exit from 7:00 to 9:00 on two weekdays and tally passers-by.
checklist.done_when: Two full counts written down for each exit

checklist.task: Interview 20 commuters about their last coffee
checklist.how: Ask what they bought this week and what it cost, never what they would buy.
checklist.done_when: 20 interviews logged, 10 or more buy coffee on the way

checklist.task: List three kiosks under 45 m² for rent
checklist.how: Search listings and walk the streets around the two exits.
checklist.done_when: Three kiosks with rent, size and licence status noted

checklist.task: Run a pop-up cart for two mornings
checklist.how: Borrow a cart and sell flat whites at €3.20 from 7:00 to 9:30.
checklist.done_when: 60 or more cups sold in two mornings

checklist.task: Get two quotes for an espresso machine lease
checklist.how: Call two local suppliers and ask for a 24-month lease with service.

checklist.task: Pick the name and order 50 sample cups
checklist.how: Choose one of Nova's three names and print a short run of cups.

checklist.task: Send the pre-order page to 50 people
checklist.how: Message everyone you interviewed and two local neighbourhood groups.

checklist.task: Publish the first three launch posts
checklist.how: Post on the planned days and answer every comment the same day.
checklist.done_when: Three posts live, every comment answered

checklist.how: Follow up in person with everyone who opened the page.

checklist.task: Decide whether to sign the lease
checklist.how: Compare cart sales and pre-orders with the break-even line.
checklist.done_when: Go or no-go written down with the numbers

leo.headline: Win the 7 to 9 am commuter gap.
leo.summary: Morning demand at metro exits is strong and few specialty cafés open before 9:00. Commuters accept a premium price if service takes under two minutes.

signals.name: Demand
signals.why: Thousands pass a central metro exit every morning

signals.name: Price acceptance
signals.why: Commuters already pay €3 or more for chain coffee

signals.name: Channel
signals.why: Street visibility is free, social reach is unproven

signals.name: Timing
signals.why: Office attendance keeps morning traffic steady

leo.why_go: Strong morning demand, almost no early-opening specialty cafés and a price commuters already pay.

risks.risk: Rent next to metro exits is high.
risks.mitigation: Start with a 40 m² takeaway kiosk with no seating.
Test a 13:00 to 15:00 coffee push during the cart week.
Keep a two-drink morning menu and time every order at the cart.

leo.next_step: Run a two-morning pop-up cart at the busier exit and count cups sold at €3.20.

market_facts.fact: A central metro exit in Eixample can see several thousand people between 7:00 and 9:00.
Specialty flat whites in central Barcelona usually cost €3.00 to €3.80.
Most specialty cafés in the area open at 8:30 or later.
A takeaway kiosk needs one barista per 60 to 80 drinks an hour at peak.

memo.purpose: A takeaway specialty coffee kiosk at a metro exit in Eixample, for commuters who want good coffee before 9:00.
memo.problem: Between 7:00 and 9:00 commuters pick between fast generic coffee and good coffee that opens too late. Queues at bakery counters make many skip it.
memo.insight: Almost no specialty café is open before 8:30, and commuters already pay €3 or more. A two-drink menu served in 90 seconds owns that window.
memo.verdict_line: Leo scores it 7.8/10: go, if you can reach about 186 customers a day.
